title: Snowflake: set up an account for a client project
summary: Open a Snowflake account in the client's name, set up a spending cap, roles, warehouses and a RAW, STAGING and MARTS database with one script, then prove the client's files load with a first test load.
time: About 45 minutes, plus 30 for a first test load

title: dbt: set up dbt Core with Snowflake for a client project
summary: Install dbt Core in a virtual environment, give it a key-pair service user in Snowflake with the least rights it needs, start a project with dev and prod targets and sources, and prove it all with a first run of tests.
